about.registryInfo: Vision 87 by Champfleury: an 87-unit, $23M tokenized slice of the ~$300M, ~960-unit Project Champfleury residential development in Quebec, tokenized by T-RIZE Group in collaboration with Republic. Distinct from T-RIZE's RIZE utility token. Full supply currently held in one platform escrow contract; rental-income distributions promised post-construction.
